newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Carroll County, Md..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Carroll County, Md..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the County Commissioners of Carroll County, Maryland (the County'') will receive written sealed bids for the $21,000,000 General Obligation Consolidated Public Improvement Bonds of 1996 (the
Bonds'') until 11:00 a.m. local Baltimore, Maryland time on:

at the offices of Piper &Marbury L.L.P., Conference Room 11A, Eleventh Floor, 36 S. Charles Street, Baltimore, Maryland, 21201. The Bonds will be dated December 1, 1996 and will mature on December 1 in the years 1997 through 2016 as more fully described in the Notice of Sale. No bid for less than all of the Bonds will be considered. The Bonds will be awarded based on the lowest interest cost to the County, determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method. All bids must be accompanied by a good faith deposit in the amount of $420,000, payable to the order of the County Commissioners of Carroll County, Maryland. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and form of proposal relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the office of the Comptroller, County Commissioners of Carroll County, County Office Building, 225 N. Center Street, Westminster, Maryland 21157, or from H.C. Wainwright & Co., 100 East Pratt Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21202 (410) 347-3900.
